name: Hoka no Otoko no Seieki de Haramu Toki ~Fusuma no Mukou de Otouto no Seieki o Sosogikomareteiru Tsuma~
original_name: 他の男の精液で孕むとき～襖の向こうで弟に精液を注ぎ込まれている妻～
source:
The protagonist, Satou Hideaki, is the young head of a distinguished family in a rural area. Although he and his beloved wife, Emi, try to conceive regularly, she just can’t seem to get pregnant. And for good reason: Hideaki’s semen contained no sperm.

As the head of a prestigious family with a long history, he simply cannot afford not to produce an heir.
And his beloved wife, Emi, also longs for a child…

After much anguish, Hideaki makes a request of his younger brother, Shuuma.
…It was a request to get his beloved wife, Emi, pregnant.

Though confused, Shuuma makes love to Emi. Even as she knows she shouldn’t, Emi loses herself in the pleasure of Shuuma’s skill. The sensuous moans of his beloved wife echo throughout the house.

Hideaki waits patiently in the next room for the insemination to end. Until the very moment his beloved wife becomes pregnant with his younger brother’s semen…

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ006277.html/]dlsite[/url]]
